text:
ops-bot: @here Heads-up: expanding the Blackwell B500 Dedicated preview into canada-east (Montreal) and us-west-2 (Oregon) this week. Initial capacity: Montreal: 8 GPUs (2 nodes) labeled b500-canada-preview; US-WEST-2: 12 GPUs (3 nodes) labeled b500-usw2-preview. This is PREVIEW only — read details below.
eli_pm: Reminder: preview = no SLA, restricted billing, and limited support. Interested teams/customers must fill the preview form: https://redwood.example.com/b500-preview. Include primary model families, expected concurrency, and whether you need KMS/HSM.
sanjay_infra: Deployment notes: Montreal nodes come with HSM enabled out of the gate (b500-canada-preview-hsm). US-WEST-2 will be HSM-disabled for initial rollout due to partner lab schedule; we expect HSM on within 72h. These pools are non-preemptible for the preview and have a default 8h session cap.
marina_prod: Perf quicktake for 8k context (internal runs): Montreal p50 112ms/token, p95 310ms/token. US-WEST-2 p50 125ms/token, p95 345ms/token. We saw a spike in latency when nodes hit 90% mem utilization on long sequences; recommend limiting simultaneous large-batch warmups.
carlos_sre: Reliability notes: one Montreal node reported a temp spike after prolonged stress testing; auto-throttle engaged and task migrated. We increased early-warning thresholds for Montreal to temp>=80C and mem errs>2/min. Added per-node power-cycle playbook to the b500 runbook.
anya_sales: GTM note: do NOT market availability as GA. Call it an "early regional preview". If partners ask for reserved billing, route to me with justification and QPS estimates. Current invited partners list: ProtoTech, EdgeSense, LangLabs (same pilot cohort as EU/AP).
ben_security: Security guidance: Montreal HSM nodes are appropriate for non-production PII with controls, but do not treat preview keys as GA-grade. US-WEST-2 preview is NOT compliant; do NOT run regulated datasets there. All preview pools are logged but logs have reduced retention compared to GA.
lucy_eng: Quick ops tip: if you hit cold KV misses, try pre-warming with two ~4-token prompts and one representative long prompt. Example reserve command for a short smoke run:
```
redwood reserve --pool b500-canada-preview-hsm --count 1 --duration 3h --team=vision --note "montreal smoke"
```
sanjay_infra: Admin: pool names are b500-canada-preview-hsm, b500-usw2-preview. We enabled node-level telemetry and a dedicated perf CI job that will auto-run nightly. If you need extended sessions, open a request in the infra-admin panel and tag infra.
marina_prod: Action items: - eng-runtime: post perf spreadsheet and CI links to #eng-runtime by EOD tomorrow - infra: enable HSM for US-WEST-2 if no blockers (ETA 72h) - SRE: add Montreal power-cycle playbook to runbook (ETA 48h) - GTM: hold public messaging and funnel partner interest to anya_sales
carlos_sre: Monitoring: added a Canada topology card and per-node SSD health checks for Montreal. Pager rules: temp>=80C pages oncall, mem errs>2/min pages infra.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Epic created: b500-canada-usw-rollout. If you observe any data privacy or security flags, DM ben_security and add the tag [b500-preview] to the bug. Thanks team!
